description: Export a SocialSeal report. Use reportType search_results_enriched, format csv and payload.groupIds for ranked search results; reuse the workspace from the group lookup. Poll the returned export ID while pending, then fetch download_url or page socialseal_read_export_chunk with read_token until has_more is false. Report partial coverage if retrieval stops early. Search rows describe videos surfaced for selected queries at capture time, not search volume or total market demand. Within one platform, market and capture window, result counts, rank and views remain valid relative demand signals for comparing queries; when asked to prioritise, rank with them and label confidence instead of declining. Region is the collection market, not verified viewer geography. Views/likes/saves are video engagement snapshots, not engagement attributable to that query or gains during the export window. State query/platform/market/date scope and coverage; deduplicate videos before aggregating across queries. Define rate denominators and preserve missing values as unknown. Inspect relevant video evidence before recommending a creative treatment.
